description: Nurse Database Gallery View - photo-first Airtable-style card grid with search, filter, sort, and view toggle controls. This is the default view at /nurses.
steps: Create src/app/nurses/page.tsx as a server component that fetches all nurses from the database and renders the NurseDatabase client component
Create src/app/nurses/layout.tsx with the page structure (header with title, controls bar, content area)
Create src/components/nurses/NurseDatabase.tsx as the main client component that manages view state (gallery/pipeline/table) and renders the appropriate view. Gallery is the DEFAULT view.
Create src/components/nurses/GalleryView.tsx - renders a responsive grid of NurseCard components. Grid should be 4 columns on large screens, 3 on medium, 2 on small, 1 on mobile.

Create src/components/nurses/NurseGalleryCard.tsx - the individual gallery card showing: circular photo (or Propela purple initials avatar if no photo URL), full name (bold), CV score as 1-5 stars (half-stars supported using a StarRating component), years experience badge, primary clinical specialty, province/city location, readiness status badge (color-coded per PRD), Next Action badge (MOST PROMINENT element - large, color-coded: Overdue=#EF4444, Due Today=#F59E0B, Upcoming=#0D9488, No action=#9CA3AF), flag indicator (red dot with count if flagCount > 0)

Create src/components/nurses/StarRating.tsx - renders 1-5 stars with half-star support. Full star = filled, half star = half-filled, empty star = outline. Uses Propela purple color for filled portions.

Create src/components/nurses/ViewControls.tsx - toolbar with: Search input (magnifying glass icon, searches by name), Group By dropdown, Filter panel button (opens a sheet/drawer with filter options for pipeline stage, readiness status, specialty, location), Sort dropdown (by name, CV score, years experience, submitted date), View toggle buttons (Gallery active by default, Pipeline, Table)

Create src/components/nurses/FilterPanel.tsx - a sheet/drawer that opens from the right with filter checkboxes for: Pipeline Stage (all stages), Readiness Status (all statuses), Specialty (dynamic from data), Location/Province (dynamic from data). Include Apply and Reset buttons.

Create src/lib/nurse-utils.ts with helper functions: getReadinessColor(status) returns the correct color code, getNextActionColor(action) returns urgency color, calculateCvScore(nurse) implements the formula (Hospital Exp x3 + SANC Status x3 + Qualifications x2 + Specialisation x1) / 9 * 5, calculateFinalScore(nurse) implements sum of all weighted scores / 15, getTier(finalScore) returns tier label, getReadinessFromStage(pipelineStage) auto-calculates readiness status from pipeline stage
Create src/store/nurse-store.ts using Zustand - manages: viewMode (gallery/pipeline/table), searchQuery, activeFilters, sortField, sortDirection, groupBy. Include actions for updating each.
Wire up the search functionality to filter nurses by name (case-insensitive contains)
Wire up the sort functionality to sort by name, cvScore, yearsExperience, or submittedAt
Ensure the gallery cards are clickable and navigate to /nurses/[id] (the nurse card detail view)
acceptance_criteria: /nurses route renders the Gallery View by default showing all seeded nurses
Each gallery card displays: photo/initials avatar, name, star rating, years badge, specialty, location, readiness badge, Next Action badge (most prominent), flag indicator
Next Action badge is the most visually prominent element on each card with correct color coding
Readiness status badges have correct color coding per PRD
Stars render correctly with half-star support
Search filters nurses by name in real-time
Sort changes the order of displayed cards
View toggle buttons are present (Gallery highlighted as active)
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm it exits with code 0
findings: 1. Build passes with NODE_OPTIONS='' npx next build (exit 0). 2. Gallery view is the default view at /nurses. 3. Star rating uses calculateCvScore formula: (hospitalExp*3 + sancStatusScore*3 + qualifications*2 + specialisation*1) / 9 * 5, capped at 5. 4. Next Action badge is most prominent with color coding (red for overdue, amber for due-today, teal for upcoming, grey for no action). 5. Filter panel extracts province from provinceCity field (splits on comma). 6. Pipeline and Table views show placeholder until implemented in FEAT-004/FEAT-005. 7. npx next lint fails due to sandbox proxy-bootstrap module issue (not related to code).
